snippet.description:
I-Popstar Hindi Vol. 2 is streaming on Alright TV app and Netflix

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday on Alright TV app at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://alrighttv.go.link/9AuBt

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday on Netflix at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://www.netflix.com/search?q=i-popstar&jbv=83190432

👉 Subscribe to Saregama Music: https://bit.ly/3FkAS0W

Credits:

Track Name: UP Wali Laiki
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Nishant Mukta
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah
Lyrics Supervisor: Pinky Poonawala
Arranged and programmed by: Muheet Bharti
Mixed and Mastered by : Sachin Nair at Sonic Jungle Studios
Dolby Atmos :Team CFP
Head Mix Engineer - Nikhil Mathew
Assisted by - Abhishek Poojary, Gayatri Karekar, Subhashree Das
Mixes supervised by Sunny M.R. for Chordfather Productions
Vocal Coaches: Bhavya Pandit & Divya S Iyer
Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:

Verse 1
Ada kare e qatal tohar jab short dress me aawelu
UP se aake gori pura Bihar hilawelu
Laal laal tor gaal ba bola kawn cream lagawelu
Hot dress tor fit ba kauna darji se silwabelu

Your style is deadly when you come wearing a short dress.
Coming from UP, girl, you shake up the whole of Bihar.
Your cheeks are so red — tell me, what cream do you apply?
Your hot dress fits you so perfectly — which tailor stitched it for you?

---

Chorus
Chain kho gayil aur karar kho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar hogayi
Okra bina jeena dushwar ho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar ho gayil

I have lost my peace, I have lost my composure.
I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.
Living without her has become impossible.
I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.

---

Verse 2
Hosh me na bani rani dekhni jab se chehra tohar
2 go bodyguard rakhelu ghar ke bahar pehra tohar
Chual chahatani tohke hath pe hmra kabu naikhe
Tohra ke bhagaleti baki dar lage tora babuji se

I haven't been in my senses since the moment I saw your face, my queen.
You keep two bodyguards outside your house to stand guard.
I want to touch you, but I have no control over my hands.
I would run away with you, but I'm afraid of your father.

---

Pre-Chorus
Ab hamke tadpawa
Tu pajara hamra aawa
Ab hamke tadpawa
Tu pajara hamra aawa

Now don't keep me longing for you.
Come close to me.
Now don't keep me longing for you.
Come close to me.

---

Chorus
Ratiya ke neendiyan haram ho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar ho gayil

My night's sleep has been ruined.
I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.

---

Verse 3
Tohra ke bana ke rakhab ham rani rani
Rangdar jila patna ke bani rani
Ek beri hamro batiya mani rani
Nishant ke kai dehlu tu pani pani

I will keep you like a queen, my queen.
I am a tough guy from the district of Patna, my queen.
Just listen to me once, my queen.
You have left Nishant completely overwhelmed.

---

Outro
Bat suna dher intezar ho gayil
UP wali laiki se pyar hogayil
Hamke pyar hogayil
Hamke pyar ho gayil
Hamke pyar hogayil

Listen to me, I have waited for you for so long.
I have fallen in love with that girl from UP.
I've fallen in love.
I've fallen in love.
I've fallen in love.

snippet.title: Sirima Siri Ni Kanchha | सिरीमा सिरी नि कान्छा | Narayan Gopal Cover | Sajilo Beats
snippet.description:
सिरीमा सिरी नि कान्छा — Sirima Siri Ni Kanchha | A classic Nepali folk song reimagined cover by Sajilo Beats.

सिरीसिरी चल्ने बतास, बाबरी फूलको बासना, मर्स्याङ्दीको किनार र गाउँघरको मायालु भेटघाट—यी मिठा अनुभूतिहरू समेटिएको नेपाली लोकगीतलाई नयाँ सांगीतिक प्रस्तुतिमा सुन्नुहोस्।

मौलिक लोकभाव र परिचित धुनप्रतिको सम्मानसँगै बाँसुरी, मादल, गितार, आधुनिक ड्रम र गहिरो बासको मेल प्रस्तुत गर्ने हाम्रो प्रयास। नेपाली संगीतका अग्रज स्रष्टाहरूप्रति यो प्रस्तुति सादर समर्पित छ।

Experience the romance, playful conversation and village memories of Siri Ma Siri Ni Kanchha through a modern Nepali folk arrangement. This cover celebrates the song’s familiar melody and joyful spirit while exploring a fresh instrumental sound.

🎵 ORIGINAL SONG CREDITS
Song: Siri Ma Siri Ni Kanchha
Original singers: Gyanu Rana & Narayan Gopal
Lyrics and music: Dharmaraj Thapa
Label / reference channel: Music Nepal

Credits above follow the information published in the linked Music Nepal video.

Watch and support the original artists’ work:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aZgmCwmws0o

With respect and appreciation for the original singers, lyricist, composer, musicians and rights holders.

🎧 THIS PRESENTATION
Cover presentation and visual concept: Sajilo Beats
Version: AI-assisted Nepali folk cover

AI DISCLOSURE
AI tools were used in creating this cover’s vocals, musical arrangement and visuals. This is a new AI-assisted interpretation, not a new performance by Gyanu Rana or Narayan Gopal. The visuals are artistic representations. No affiliation with or endorsement by the original artists, their representatives or Music Nepal is implied.

Listen with headphones to enjoy the flute, madal, guitar and layered instrumental details.

If you enjoy Nepali songs, Nepali cover songs, Nepali folk songs, classic Nepali lok geet and modern folk fusion, subscribe to Sajilo Beats. Tell us which line brings back your favourite memory.

Known as Sirima Siri Ni Kanchha or Siri Ma Siri Ni Kanchha, this beloved song evokes “सुन मेरो निर्माया,” the fragrance of Babari flowers and the banks of the Marsyangdi River. Our presentation connects those lyrical images with the warmth of old Nepali songs and a contemporary cover arrangement.

bn.title: 😱ম্যাজিকাল ঘড়ি ব্যবহার করে GTA 5-এ প্রতিটি সুপারহিরো হিসেবে খেলছে ফ্র্যাঙ্কলিন!
bn.description:
😱ফ্র্যাঙ্কলিন GTA 5-এর প্রতিটি রহস্যময় কন্টেইনার খুলছে

ডিসক্লেইমার

এই ভিডিওটি গ্র্যান্ড থেফট অটো V (GTA V) ভিডিও গেমের মধ্যে সম্পূর্ণভাবে তৈরি একটি সিনেম্যাটিক গেমপ্লে স্টোরি।

এখানে দেখানো সমস্ত চরিত্র, যুদ্ধ, যানবাহন, ইফেক্ট এবং ঘটনা কাল্পনিক এবং একটি সিমুলেটেড ভার্চুয়াল গেম পরিবেশে ঘটে। যেকোনো অ্যাকশন সিকোয়েন্স, যুদ্ধের দৃশ্য বা ধ্বংসযজ্ঞ গেমের মেকানিক্সের অংশ এবং বাস্তব নয়।

এই কন্টেন্টটি কঠোরভাবে বিনোদন এবং গল্প বলার উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি করা হয়েছে এবং এটি বাস্তব জগতের সহিংসতা, ক্ষতিকর আচরণ বা বিপজ্জনক কার্যকলাপকে উৎসাহিত করে না।

কিছু চরিত্র জনপ্রিয় কাল্পনিক জগৎ থেকে অনুপ্রাণিত হতে পারে। তাদের নিজ নিজ চরিত্র এবং মেধাস্বত্বের সমস্ত অধিকার তাদের মূল নির্মাতাদের। এই ভিডিওটি একটি ফ্যান-মেড, রূপান্তরমূলক গেমপ্লে প্রজেক্ট এবং এটি কোনো স্বত্বাধিকারীর সাথে যুক্ত বা তাদের দ্বারা অনুমোদিত নয়।

গেমপ্লের ভিজ্যুয়াল এবং গল্প বলার মান উন্নত করতে মোড এবং কাস্টম অ্যাসেট ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে। সমস্ত দৃশ্য গেমের পরিবেশের মধ্যেই রেকর্ড করা হয়েছে।

snippet.title: Parvati (Full Audio) | Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati | Hanuman Ansh |Sadhu Tiwari |Parvati Parvati Song
snippet.description:
Turn up the full audio of ‘Parvati’ (Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati) from Hanuman Ansh and experience the song in its complete form. Sung, written, and composed by Sadhu Tiwari, the Hanuman Ansh song brings Maa Parvati’s strong faith, tapasya, and determination to marry Lord Shankar to life.

The song is part of the Hanuman Ansh movie, a film based on the life and spiritual journey of Neem Karoli Baba (Maharaj-ji). Through its music, the film brings together stories of faith, devotion, and surrender that have connected deeply with audiences.

Listen to the full audio of ‘Parvati’ and feel the devotion of Maa Parvati and Lord Shiva. Explore more songs from Hanuman Ansh and continue the musical journey of the film.

snippet.description:

Song Credits:
Song Name - Tera Hone Laga Hoon
Movie Name - Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
Singer -Atif Aslam, Alisha Chinai
Lyrics - Ashish Pandit
Music Director - Pritam

Movie Cast & Crew :
Producer : Ramesh S. Taurani
Director : Rajkumar Santoshi
Cast : Ranbir Kapoor, Katrina Kaif & Upen Patel

Song Lyrics :

Shining in the sand in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and feel me, Ho Feel me 
Shining in the shed in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and heal me, O Heal me 

Thinking about the love n making The Life for sharing 
Come and feel me O feel me 
Shining in the sand in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and feel me, Come on Heal me.. 

Hua Jo tu bhi mera Mera, Tera Jo ikrarr hua 
To kyun na mein bhi, Keh dun keh dun 
Hua mujhe bhi Pyaar hua 
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon 
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon

Shining in the sand in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and feel me, O Feel me 
Shining in the shade in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and Heal me.. O Heal me.. 
umm waise to maan mera 
Phele bhi raaton mein 

Aksar hi chahat ke haan, Sapne Sanjota tha 
Phele bhi dhadkan yeh, Dhoonn koi gaati thi 
Par abb jo hota hai who, Phele na hota tha 
Hoona hai Tujhe jo bhi jo bhi 
Mujhe bhi is paar hua

To kyun na main bhi keh doon keh doon 
hoona mujhe bhi pyaar hua
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon 

Aankhon se chhoon lu k baahein tarasti hain 
Dil ne pukaara hai haan, Ab to Chale aao 
Aao k Shabnam ki Bundein Barasti hain 
Mausam Ishaara hai haan... 
Ab to Chale aao!!
Baahon mein Daale Baahein Baahein 
Baahon ka Jaise haar hoona.. 
Haan Maana maine maana maana... 
hoona mujhe bhi pyaar hoona 
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon 
Tera hone laga hoon, Khone Laga hoon 
Jab se mila hoon 

Shining in the sand in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and feel me, Haan Feel me 
Shining in the sand in sun like a pearl up on the ocean 
Come and feel me, Haan Feel me 
Thinking about the love n making entire Life for sharing 
Come and feel me, Ho Heal me

snippet.title: इकरार हो ना जाए | Zinda Dil | Udit Narayan Songs | Abbas | Ashima Bhalla
snippet.description:
2000 के दशक का संगीत अपने आप में एक जादू है, और जब बात उदित नारायण की मखमली आवाज़ की हो, तो हर धुन दिल को छू जाती है। फिल्म 'ज़िंदा दिल' का यह प्यारा गीत 'इकरार हो ना जाए' प्यार की उन मासूम भावनाओं को बयां करता है जो आज भी ताज़ा महसूस होती हैं। यह गाना उस दौर की यादें ताज़ा करता है जब संगीत में सुकून और गहराई हुआ करती थी। 



Credits :

Song: Ikrar Ho Na Jaye
Album: Zinda Dil
Artist: Udit Narayan
Music Director: Nadeem-Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer 



Lyrics :

O ho ho ey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Saagar ki maujein hain
Khulaa aasmaan hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho ho ho ho
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Jee chaahe lahron se
Karoon main sharaarat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
Hey hey hey.. Ey hey hey
O ho ho ey hey hey.

अगर आपको यह गाना पसंद आया, तो कृपया वीडियो को लाइक करें, अपने पसंदीदा गाने के बारे में कमेंट करें और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें। आपकी प्रतिक्रिया हमारे लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

2 Allre Nani Timro  PRBT No - 80317550
3 Kholima Kanchan Pani Chha  PRBT No - 80317551

snippet.title: ITISH – Farkera Aau | Official Music Video | Nepali Rap 2026 | Kadak Nepali Record
snippet.description:
Farkera Aau — ITISH | Official Music Video

Farkera Aau by ITISH is a new Nepali rap song / Nephop song about love, heartbreak, memories, separation and wanting someone to come back. This Nepali music video tells the story of an unfinished relationship and the emotions that remain even after two people have gone their separate ways.

Sometimes, being away from someone is easier than trying to forget them. Time passes, memories slowly fade, but somewhere deep inside, one feeling still remains — Farkera Aau.

Farkera Aau is for anyone who has experienced a broken relationship, missed someone they still love, or found themselves holding on to memories that refuse to disappear. It is an emotional Nepali song about love and heartbreak, delivered through ITISH's Nepali rap and Nephop style.

Artist: ITISH
Song: Farkera Aau

ഈ വീഡിയോയിൽ എന്താണ് ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നത്

► സ്വന്തം വിഭവങ്ങൾ മാത്രം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഒരു സബ്‌സ്‌ക്രൈബറുടെ FC മൊബൈൽ അക്കൗണ്ട് അപ്‌ഗ്രേഡ് ചെയ്യുക
► സബ്‌സ്‌ക്രൈബർ നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന രണ്ട് ലക്ഷ്യങ്ങൾ: മെസ്സിയെയും റൊണാൾഡോയെയും പായ്ക്ക് ചെയ്യുക അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ക്ലെയിം ചെയ്യുക, ടീമിനെ കുറഞ്ഞത് 126 OVR-ലേക്ക് കൊണ്ടുപോകുക
► സേവ് ചെയ്‌ത ഡ്രാഫ്റ്റ് വൗച്ചറുകൾ റൊണാൾഡോ പായ്ക്കുകളിലും മെസ്സി പായ്ക്കുകളിലും ചെലവഴിക്കുക

► ദുർബലമായ സ്ഥലങ്ങൾ പരിഹരിക്കാൻ വിലകുറഞ്ഞ മൃഗവേട്ട
